`gsm.ctas` follows the IMPALA-Consortium quality-control model documented on
the [gsm.simaerep](https://impala-consortium.github.io/gsm.simaerep/) sister
package. This vignette is the canonical source; the top-level
[`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/IMPALA-Consortium/gsm.ctas/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
is a stub that links here.

## Branches

- `main` — protected. Only merged via pull request; all required checks must
  be green.
- `dev` — protected. Integration branch for the current release cycle.
- `{issue#}_short-slug` — one feature/fix branch per GitHub issue,
  cut from `dev`. The issue number prefix ties the branch to the tracker
  and to the changelog entry.

## Development process

1. Open a GitHub issue describing the change. Pick the appropriate template
   from `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`.
2. Cut a branch named `{issue#}_short-slug` from `dev`.
3. Practice test-driven development: write the failing `testthat::test_that()`
   block first, then the R code that makes it pass. Every exported function
   and every non-trivial internal helper gets a direct unit test.
4. Regenerate documentation and format code before pushing:

   ```r
   devtools::document()
   styler::style_pkg()
   ```

   The `pr-commands.yaml` workflow lets a maintainer post `/document` or
   `/style` on a pull request to run these steps in CI and commit back to
   the branch.

5. Add a bullet to `NEWS.md` under the current development header.
6. Open a pull request against `dev`. Fill in
   `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`. Every check must pass:

   - `R-CMD-check` — `R CMD check` across the OS/R-version matrix
   - `test-coverage` — coverage reporter (shared IMPALA workflow)
   - `test-coverage-strict` — hard-fails when coverage drops below 100%
   - `qcthat` — user-acceptance and QC test gate
   - `workflow-template-check` — CI template compliance
   - `pkgdown-all` — documentation site build

## Quality control

- **Unit tests.** 100% line coverage is required and enforced in CI by
  [`.github/workflows/test-coverage-strict.yaml`](https://github.com/IMPALA-Consortium/gsm.ctas/blob/main/.github/workflows/test-coverage-strict.yaml).
  Locally, iterate with `covr::report()`.
- **No `# nocov` markers.** Every line of `R/` runs under the test suite,
  including the HTML render pipeline. Widget builders in
  `R/utils_Charts.R` are exercised directly in
  `tests/testthat/test-utils_Charts.R` with
  `expect_s3_class(..., "htmlwidget")` — mirroring
  [`gsm.simaerep/tests/testthat/test_widgets.R`](https://github.com/IMPALA-Consortium/gsm.simaerep/blob/main/tests/testthat/test_widgets.R) —
  and the end-to-end `Report_CTAS()` render is exercised through the
  `report_ctas_site` module in `tests/testthat/test_workflow.R`
  with `withr::local_tempdir()` — mirroring
  [`gsm.simaerep/tests/testthat/test_workflow.R`](https://github.com/IMPALA-Consortium/gsm.simaerep/blob/main/tests/testthat/test_workflow.R).
  File I/O, input validation, data preparation and everything else must
  have real tests. This policy is also documented in the `Quality Control`
  section of `README.md`.
- **Workflow tests.** Beyond unit tests, `tests/testthat/test_workflow.R`
  exercises the full mapping → metric → reporting pipeline end-to-end.
- **Documentation.** All exported functions carry roxygen docs with runnable
  `@examples`. `devtools::document()` must produce no diff after commit.
- **Package checks.** `R CMD check` must be clean.
- **Code formatting.** `styler::style_pkg()` before push.
- **Cookbook.** Usage patterns are demonstrated in `vignette("gsm-ctas")`.

## Release process

1. Cut a release branch from `dev`, bump the `Version` field in
   `DESCRIPTION`, promote the development header in `NEWS.md`.
2. Merge to `main` via pull request; all required checks green.
3. Tag the merge commit; the `r-releaser-caller.yaml` workflow handles the
   GitHub release from there.

## Required status checks

The following must be marked as required status checks on `main` and `dev`
in the GitHub branch-protection UI (repo admins only):

- `R-CMD-check`
- `test-coverage-strict`
- `qcthat`
- `workflow-template-check`
